newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WOLTERS TO MAKE CASH DIV MORE ATTRACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: WOLTERS TO MAKE CASH DIV MORE ATTRACTIVE.

text.p: Publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Friday it was raising its dividend payout ratio to 35 percent from just over 30 percent and would also make the cash dividend more attractive than the alternative stock dividend.
Wolters Kluwer said it would submit the proposed discount of the stock dividend to the cash dividend to the annual meeting of shareholders on April 17.
Shareholders can notify the company whether they want to opt for the cash dividend or the stock dividend from April 18 to May 13, after which the stock dividend will be determined.
